name: ComfyUI v0.27.0 — native int8 model support
notes: Engine-level int8 quantization for all models. ~40–50% VRAM reduction on Flux/Klein without meaningful quality loss. Also adds ConditioningMultiply node (ControlNet weighting), Krea-2 advanced merging node, int8 LoRA quality fix, memory-leak fix. No model changes required — engine upgrade only. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Edit-Turbo
notes: 4-step DMD-distilled image editing model. Architecture: NextDiT/Lumina2-family DiT 10B + Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder + FLUX.1 VAE — architecturally adjacent to build_qwen_edit target. Apache-2.0. FP8-scaled fits 16 GB VRAM. Drops editing from ~50 to 4 steps at CFG ~1.0. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo hotfix (revision hotfix-20260625)
notes: Patch for Boogu-Image T2I Turbo fixing visual artifacts in non-square aspect ratios and background overfitting. Pin to revision hotfix-20260625 or later. IN 7-DAY WINDOW (boundary).

name: HyperSwap ONNX models (FaceFusion Labs) via ReActor New Core
notes: ReActor New Core (May 12) adds native support for hyperswap_1a/1b/1c_256.onnx from FaceFusion Labs. Sharper swaps than inswapper_128 on high-res targets. No InsightFace/C++ dependency. Place files in models/hyperswap/. Outside 7-day window.

name: Krea-2-Turbo
notes: 12B DiT, 2-step distilled, Qwen3-VL text encoder. FP8 ~12 GB VRAM — fits RTX 5060 Ti. Krea 2 Community License (free commercial <50 seats). ComfyUI native node in v0.26.0. Advanced merging node in v0.27.0 (Jun 30, in window). 69.8K downloads in 9 days. Needs new build_krea2_txt2img builder. 2 days outside window but ComfyUI integration landed in window.

name: Krea-2-Raw
notes: Base (pre-distillation) Krea-2 for LoRA training. BF16 requires 24+ GB VRAM — exceeds 16 GB budget. GGUF/FP8 community quants exist. Training base only, not a deployment checkpoint for Spellcaster target machine.

name: Seedance 2.0 Mini + 4K Partner Node (ByteDance)
notes: Cloud API Partner Node in ComfyUI v0.26.2. T2V + First-Last-Frame + Reference generation modes. 4K resolution for standard Seedance 2.0. No local VRAM cost. Supersedes Seedance 1.5 Pro. Needs new build_seedance_video builder. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: comfyui-deno-custom-nodes v0.7.63-v0.7.66
notes: Four releases Jun 26 - Jul 1 add: LTX AV Tiled Sampler (preserves audio context across tiles), LTX Tiled Spatial Upscaler (overlapping tile latents for high-res), optional RTX VSR node (RTX 5060 Ti hardware acceleration). Enables LTX 2.3 22B at 16 GB via tiled sampling. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: Cameraman IC-LoRA for LTX 2.3 22B v2.0
notes: Camera-motion IC-LoRA for LTX 2.3 22B; v2.0 with larger training set. Drives camera trajectory (not style). Drop-in LoRA slot for build_ltx_video. Works T2V and I2V. Requires GGUF Q4/Q8 for LTX 2.3 22B at 16 GB. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: Qwen3-VL-8B as optional Klein text encoder (ComfyUI v0.26.0 PR #14526)
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.0 enables Qwen3-VL-8B as text encoder for Flux2 Klein family. Improves prompt adherence for complex compositions without changing diffusion backbone. Optional — existing CLIP pairing unchanged by default. 3 days outside window but paired with in-window v0.27.0 upgrade.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap IC-LoRA (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511)
notes: IC-LoRA for Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, tagged face-swap, head-swap, comfyui, klein, flux2. Diffusion-native face swap — avoids ONNX artifacts on still frames. ~10-12 GB VRAM. Multiple forks (45-144 downloads). Check Qwen2.5 commercial license before adopting. 8 days outside window.

name: WAN 2.7 (27B/14B-active MoE, ModelScope)
notes: 27B total / 14B active MoE DiT. Apache 2.0 open weights on ModelScope (not Wan-AI HF org — frozen at 2.2). Adds audio-driven I2V, 5-person reference, instruction video editing, multi-shot narration. VRAM feasibility at 16 GB unconfirmed — needs GGUF quants (pattern from 2.2-A14B). Outside window but highest-priority video backlog item.

name: SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex
notes: Meta SAM 3.1 with shared-memory joint multi-object tracking. 2x panoptic accuracy vs SAM 3 base on multi-instance tasks. Weights available in facebookresearch/sam3. ICLR 2026. Direct upgrade for all build_sam3_* methods. ~4-8 GB VRAM. Outside window.

name: Seedance 2.5 (announced, cloud API)
notes: ByteDance announced Jun 23; public API rollout beginning ~Jul 1. 30s one-shot video (vs 10s for 2.0), up to 50 multimodal reference inputs, local region editing. Cloud API, no VRAM. No ComfyUI Partner Node as of Jul 2. Monitor.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video (Bernini-R IC-LoRA)
notes: IC-LoRA for ByteDance Bernini-R video model (Wan 2.2 renderer). Video headswap via LightX2V LoRA pairs. Community forks proliferated Jun 27-30. Bernini-R 9B is marginal at 16 GB — needs GGUF. Extends, not replaces, build_klein_headswap for still images. IN 7-DAY WINDOW.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0 Partner Node (Tencent, ComfyUI)
notes: 3D-DiT hierarchical sculpting architecture; 1536 cubed geometric resolution, 3.6B voxel ultra-HD modeling, 3x higher precision than HunyuanDiT 2.0. HIGH VRAM RISK — 2.0 required 24 GB+; 3.0 likely equal or more. Test quantized/tiled variants before enabling on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Alternative: use as cloud Partner Node only.

name: MediaPipe Face Detection + FaceMesh v2 (ComfyUI v0.23.0 core, PR #14009)
notes: BlazeFace + FaceMesh v2 (478 landmarks) + ARKit-52 blendshapes as native ComfyUI node. mediapipe_face_fp32.safetensors (Apache 2.0). ~200 MB VRAM. Sharpens face-scope masks feeding into build_face_restore pipeline. Outside window.

name: RealRestorer — Generalizable Real-World Image Restoration
notes: Open-source generalizable restoration model with RealIR-Bench benchmark. Closes gap with closed-source restoration APIs for mixed-degradation inputs. No ComfyUI wrapper as of survey. 58 HF upvotes. Outside window.

name: MiM-DiT — MoE-in-MoE Diffusion Transformer for All-in-One Restoration
notes: Dual-level MoE baked into pretrained DiT; handles haze/blur/noise/low-light with single model via adaptive expert routing. No public weights or ComfyUI wrapper confirmed yet. Outside window.

name: LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA family: Deblur, Colorization, Ingredients (Lightricks)
notes: Three new IC-LoRA adapters released alongside LTX Trainer 13-mode expansion. Additive capability for build_ltx_video (deblur, colorize, recipe-to-video use cases). 8 days outside window.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution ComfyUI node (official Comfy-Org)
notes: Official RTX upscaler node (GDC 2026). 30x faster than traditional upscalers for comparable quality. RTX 5060 Ti supported (RTX 20+ minimum). Windows-only (NVIDIA VFX SDK). Could replace build_wavespeed_upscale on Windows RTX hosts. Outside window.

name: BiRefNet-matting ONNX community export
notes: Community ONNX export of ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet-matting (same weights Spellcaster already uses). No new architectural capability. Potential ONNX inference path if latency matters. Base model unchanged since Feb 2026. IN 7-DAY WINDOW but low value.

name: WAN 2.6 open weights (Apache 2.0, ModelScope)
notes: WAN 2.6 (Dec 2025): 14B MoE, 15s at 1080p/24fps. Apache 2.0. Weights on ModelScope only — Wan-AI HF org frozen at 2.2. Superseded by WAN 2.7 for new deployments. Backlog item.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 (3B + 7B, GGUF support, ICLR 2026)
notes: v2.5 complete architecture redesign: 7B model runs on 8 GB VRAM minimum (vs much higher before). 60% VRAM reduction, 2-3x faster, dual model choice (3B noisy / 7B clean), GGUF 4-bit/8-bit. New color correction lab mode. Accepted ICLR 2026. Check if current build_seedvr2 is already pinned to v2.5 weights.
